content_blocks.steps_heading: Your CAPM Certification Pathway in Chandler

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of required project management education hours. Importantly, no prior work experience is necessary—making CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-stage professionals entering Chandler's semiconductor and technology sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. Our intensive format compresses project management fundamentals into a focused learning experience, delivered entirely online so you can prepare for certification while maintaining your current schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit PMI Application and Exam Fee
steps_items.text: Once coursework is complete, submit your PMI application directly through the Project Management Institute. You'll provide proof of your educational requirement and pay the associated examination fee to activate your CAPM exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation support to reinforce key concepts and test-taking strategies. When ready, you'll schedule and complete the proctored CAPM exam, which assesses your knowledge of project management processes and terminology.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew on a three-year cycle. You'll earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved PMI activities—training, conferences, volunteer service, or published work—to keep your certification active and demonstrate ongoing commitment to the profession.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
